subject: wharf build cache warm-up

requirements.preparationConcurrency: Add -p; precedence flag, P, WHARF_P, default 4; no run N cap.
requirements.cacheReuse: Warm the same persistent agent caches and verifier Docker build layers used by run.
requirements.safety: Wait for the active benchmark to finish before building/testing; preserve parent and persistent cache images.

findings: The previous build path omitted copilotVersion and therefore skipped persistent task-environment, CLI-payload, and composed agent caches.
The previous build path did not prepare verifier Dockerfiles.
For an ECR-backed task, the previous build path passed the parent image tag as the requested child tag.
implementation: Share CopilotAdapter version resolution without credential or invocation preparation.
Add build -p and --cli-version, matching run configuration precedence where applicable.
Bound combined agent/verifier preparation by the build task concurrency limit.
Use the existing agent preparer and verifier image builder; create and remove uniquely named build children.
Retain persistent agent caches, configured parents, and verifier Docker build cache.
Propagate cancellation and failures explicitly; attempt cleanup of both children even when one removal fails.

validation.testExecution: 147 passed on the initial run. An ECR test fixture incorrectly placed task.toml at the collection root; after fixing its layout, the targeted test passed.

limits: Image cache warm-up does not precompile an unknown agent patch or populate workspace caches created only by agent/grader execution.
Use the same exact CLI version for build and run; latest can change between invocations.
Verifier reuse relies on Docker build cache; this change does not introduce a persistent verifier cache-image contract.
